info.name: Banking Transactions API
info.description:
Homework 1 - in-memory banking transactions service (Express 5).

- **Auth:** none.
- **Content type:** JSON requests and responses.
- **Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:3000`, port from `PORT`).

Run folders in order: *Create transaction* saves `depositId`, used by later requests.
Every request has test scripts, so the collection can run with `postman collection run`.

request.description:
Liveness probe. No parameters.

**200** `{ "status": "ok" }`

item.name: Create transaction
item.description:
`POST /transactions` — records a transaction. Body must be a JSON object with `Content-Type: application/json` (max 100kb).

| Field | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `deposit` \| `withdrawal` \| `transfer` |
| `amount` | yes | JSON number, `> 0`, `<= 1000000000`, at most 2 decimal places |
| `currency` | yes | Uppercase ISO 4217, one of: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, CNY, SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN, CZK, UAH |
| `fromAccount` | withdrawal, transfer | `ACC-` + 5 letters/digits (case-sensitive); must be absent or `null` for deposit |
| `toAccount` | deposit, transfer | Same format; must be absent or `null` for withdrawal; must differ from `fromAccount` |
| `timestamp` | no | ISO 8601 with seconds and timezone (`Z` or `±hh:mm`), not in the future. Defaults to server time; stored as UTC |

Any other field is rejected (`id`, `status`, `failureReason` are server-set). All problems are reported at once.

**201 Created** + `Location: /transactions/{id}`
```json
{ "id": "uuid", "fromAccount": "ACC-12345 | null", "toAccount": "ACC-67890 | null", "amount": 100.5,
  "currency": "USD", "type": "deposit", "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z", "status": "completed" }
```
Currently every created transaction has `status: "completed"`.

item.name: Create transaction - validation errors
item.description:
Expected: **400** with
```json
{ "error": "Validation failed", "details": [{ "field": "...", "message": "..." }] }
```
`details` lists every problem in field order (`fromAccount`, `toAccount`, `amount`, `currency`, `type`, `timestamp`), then unknown fields.

item.name: Empty object - all required fields missing

request.description: An empty body with JSON content type behaves the same.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "amount", "message": "Amount is required"}, {"field": "currency", "message": "Currency is required"}, {"field": "type", "message": "Type is required"}]);

request.description: Arrays, or a request without `Content-Type: application/json`, are rejected as a whole.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "body", "message": "Request body must be a JSON object"}]);

request.description: Unparseable JSON, or a top-level primitive such as `"x"` or `null`.
The pre-request script builds a ~110kb body. Expected **413** with the same error shape.
`id`, `status`, `failureReason` are set by the server; any other extra field is unknown.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "id", "message": "id is set by the server and must not be sent"}, {"field": "status", "message": "status is set by the server and must not be sent"}, {"field": "note", "message": "Unknown field \"note\""}]);

request.description: Zero and negative amounts are rejected.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "amount", "message": "Amount must be a positive number"}]);
pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "amount", "message": "Amount must have at most 2 decimal places"}]);

request.description: Numeric strings are not accepted.
Codes are case-sensitive and limited to the supported list.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "currency", "message": "Unsupported currency code. Supported: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, CNY, SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN, CZK, UAH"}]);

request.description: With an unknown type no account is required; only the format of supplied accounts is checked.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "type", "message": "Type must be one of: deposit, withdrawal, transfer"}]);

request.description: Prefix is case-sensitive and exactly 5 characters must follow.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "toAccount", "message": "Account must match the format ACC-XXXXX, where X is a letter or digit"}]);
pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "fromAccount", "message": "fromAccount must not be set for a deposit"}]);
pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "fromAccount", "message": "fromAccount is required for a withdrawal"}, {"field": "toAccount", "message": "toAccount must not be set for a withdrawal"}]);
pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "toAccount", "message": "toAccount must be different from fromAccount"}]);

request.description: Seconds and a timezone (`Z` or `±hh:mm`) are mandatory.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "timestamp", "message": "Timestamp must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"}]);

request.description: Calendar dates are checked, e.g. 30 February.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "timestamp", "message": "Timestamp must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"}]);

request.description: The pre-request script sets `futureTimestamp` to now + 1 day.

exec: pm.expect(body.details).to.eql([{"field": "timestamp", "message": "Timestamp must not be in the future"}]);
